category_title: Unmotivated rising first graders with significant letter-sound recognition deficits and high interest in specific machinery
scenario_title: Writing proficiency evaluation and sentence generation
minimal_context: Derek is sitting in the Literacy Corner during a one-on-one tutoring session, tasked with writing his name and a sentence of his choice in his reflection journal.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please write your first and last name in your reflection journal, and then write a sentence of your choice.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know all the letters.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to write what you can.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to write a sentence about a green tractor. But I don't know how to make the sentence.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and try writing the words down on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it! I don't know how to form the letters or write the simple sight words.
